text:
maya (acct exec): NimbusPay wants a short 2-week eval to replace CompetitorY. Main asks: prompt parity, webhook signature compatibility, EU data residency, and a pricing comparison for their high-volume flows. Can we scope?
ryan (solutions): On it. Do they push events via signed webhooks or poll? Also: which endpoints are most latency-sensitive?
maya (acct exec): They push signed webhooks and use low-latency sync for authorization messages. High volume: ~120 reqs/s during peak.
isa (engineer): Heads up: CompetitorY streams with 1KB chunks; our streaming uses adaptive chunking which can land different websocket reconnection semantics. We should prepare a minimal adapter on client or recommend client tweaks.
tasha (security): Security checklist: KMS/HSM requirement, SOC2 + ISO certs, need to know if they require a mutual TLS endpoint. Also GDPR: EU-only processing for payment tokens.
ryan (solutions): Ask NimbusPay to send a sanitized sample of their top 10 prompts + representative webhook payloads. We'll run side-by-side on identical prompts and produce a short delta report (token delta, 1-2 example response diffs).
maya (acct exec): I'll request that and their legal/security contacts.
isa (engineer): Quick smoke command we can give them to run client-side for parity testing: 
```
# run against Redwood hosted compat endpoint
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-compat-stream","prompt":"<<sanitized prompt>>","max_tokens":200,"stream":false}'
```
Then run the same prompt against CompetitorY and paste outputs. We'll diff with `wdiff` or a simple tokenized diff.
ryan (solutions): For pricing, let's prepare: 1) expected tokens per prompt (estimates), 2) cost per 1M tokens, 3) projected monthly bill at current traffic, 4) an optional POC credit. Recommend a 2-week POC credit equal to 40% of projected POC spend to reduce lift for them.
tasha (security): For VPC/Dedicated: confirm EU region availability and lead time. Also need to confirm whether they require IP egress blocklist or allowed-list. If they require HSM, note that Dedicated with our KMS bridge supports customer-managed keys.
infra-bot: New request: open infra ticket INF-2026-789 to reserve a temporary Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 for the POC. ETA: 5 business days for provisioning.
isa (engineer): Potential blocker: CompetitorY signs webhooks using an HMAC with header X-CX-SIG. Our webhook signature is different (X-RWD-SIG). We'll provide a small shim in the POC proxy to verify both and re-sign to keep NimbusPay's existing verifier.
ryan (solutions): Also check prompt conditioning: CompetitorY strips trailing whitespace and auto-lowercases system instructions in some SDKs. That can affect parity. Ask NimbusPay to include raw prompt as sent by their SDK.
maya (acct exec): I'll capture raw SDK payloads. Also NimbusPay asked about hallucination behavior on monetary facts. Request: any existing guardrails?
isa (engineer): We'll include a recommended guardrail: set logits bias and temperature to low values and validate against a small truth-set in POC. If we see hallucination gaps, propose a small post-filter step in the request path.
ryan (solutions): Timeline: once artifacts are in (prompts, webhooks, contacts), we can ship a POC package in 3 business days: config, token-delta table, shim instructions, pricing estimate, security docs. Provisioning Dedicated in EU adds 5 days.
tasha (security): NDA/DSA? If legal contact provided, we can push an MSA addendum + one-way NDA in <24h. Need to get their DPO contact for GDPR DPIA scope.
maya (acct exec): I'll gather artifacts today. Tasha, Ryan, Isa: can you confirm you can support the 2-week window if we get artifacts by tomorrow noon?
ryan (solutions): Yes.
isa (engineer): Yes, can run the side-by-side and prepare shim config.
tasha (security): Yes, will join the security calls and review questionnaire.
maya (acct exec): Great — I'll update NimbusPay: 1) we can do the POC, 2) need raw prompts + webhook samples + legal contact, 3) expect POC bundle in 3 business days after artifacts, 4) Dedicated EU lead time ~5 days, 5) recommended POC credit 40%.
ryan (solutions): One more: suggest we include a small integration checklist for their engineers (webhook headers to accept, reconnect logic, token estimate generator). Saves time.
isa (engineer): I'll draft the checklist and sample shim code (node/python) for verifying/rewriting webhook signatures.
maya (acct exec): Perfect, thanks team. I'll post NimbusPay contacts when I have them.
infra-bot: INF-2026-789 created.
maya (acct exec): Thanks all :pray:
